chunks: Description of the Creation of Adam (peace be upon him)

Then He (Glorified be He) collected from the hard and soft parts of the earth, its sweet and salty parts, clay which He mixed with water until it became pure, and kneaded it with moisture until it became gluey. From it He fashioned a form having curves and joints, limbs and segments: He solidified it until it dried up, and hardened it until it made a sound, for a fixed time and a known duration,

Then He blew into it from His Spirit, whereupon it took the pattern of a human being with minds that govern him, intelligence which he utilizes, limbs that serve him, organs that change his position, and knowledge by which he differentiates between truth and falsehood, tastes and smells, colors and species.
A mixture of clays of different colors, cohesive materials, divergent contradictories, and differing properties, such as heat and cold, moisture and dryness, grief and joy.
ai.seo_question: How was Adam created according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the cosmological process of Adam’s creation, emphasizing the transition from heterogeneous earth to a unified, solidified form before the infusion of the divine spirit (Ruh). This description highlights the dual nature of humanity, combining physical composition with intellectual and spiritual faculties, a concept central to Shia anthropological thought regarding the perfection of the human form as a vessel for divine knowledge. The text underscores the deliberate timing ('ajal ma'lum') of this creation, linking the physical formation to a predetermined spiritual destiny.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Description of the Creation of Adam :

Allāh collected from hard, soft, sweet and sour earth, clay which He dripped in water till it got pure, and kneaded it with moisture till it became gluey. From it He carved an image with curves, joints, limbs and segments. He solidified it till it dried up for a fixed time and a known duration.

Then He blew into it out of His Spirit whereupon it took the pattern of a human being with mind that governs him, intelligence which he makes use of, limbs that serve him, organs that change his position, sagacity that differentiates between truth and untruth, tastes and smells, colours and species.
He is a mixture of clays of different colours, cohesive materials, divergent contradictories and differing properties like heat, cold, softness and hardness, grief and joy.
